act_title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

quests.title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

dialogue.t: So, you just need to clear out the monsters around here, right?
All of them across this entire area, actually. We can do a little at a time, though. Step by step — just like dancing.
Oh, got it... Guess the Fatui does do good deeds sometimes, huh?
Hehe, guess you're right! Keeping monsters from invading this area is a good thing for sure!
Well, let's get moving, shall we?
